simulation_disclaimer: ROVERSE Health Assistant is a proposed educational simulation prototype for Mars exploration planning. It does NOT provide medical advice, diagnosis, dosing, or prescribing. In any actual terrestrial emergency, immediately contact local emergency services (e.g. 911/112).

emergency_action_protocol.action_required: IMMEDIATELY ABORT EVA ACTIVITY AND RETURN TO BASE AIRLOCK.
steps: 1. CEASE ALL PHYSICAL TRAVERSE AND SAMPLE COLLECTION IMMEDIATELY.
2. ACTIVATE SECONDARY OXYGEN PURGE AND STABILIZE SUIT PRESSURE TO 29.6 kPa.
3. INITIATE IMMEDIATE RETURN PROTOCOL TO BASE AIRLOCK WITH CREW BUDDY ASSIST.
4. TRANSMIT HIGHEST-PRIORITY MAYDAY / MEDICAL TELEMETRY TO MISSION CONTROL (SIMULATION).
5. IN ANY REAL EMERGENCY ON EARTH: IMMEDIATELY CALL LOCAL EMERGENCY SERVICES (911 / 112 / EMERGENCY CLINIC).
emergency_action_protocol.medical_disclaimer: This is an automated safety emergency response from the ROVERSE educational simulation. It is not medical advice.

hydration.guidelines: Suited explorers consume 250-400 mL/hr of electrolyte-balanced water via in-suit drink bag. Avoid dehydration to maintain cognitive acuity and reduce hypothermia vulnerability. Monitor urine specific gravity pre- and post-EVA.

thermal_stress.topic: Thermal Regulation in Mars EVA Suits
thermal_stress.guidelines: Martian ambient temperatures reach below -60°C. The Liquid Cooling and Ventilation Garment (LCVG) manages metabolic heat. Adjust thermoelectric heating loops for distal extremities (fingers/toes) during stationary science sampling.

fatigue_and_metabolic_rate.guidelines: Walking on Mars gravity (0.38g) in a 120-kg suit expends ~200-350 W. Maintain cadence below 2.5 km/h on slopes exceeding 10°. Mandatory 5-minute rest breaks every 45 minutes of traverse.

radiation_hygiene.guidelines: Nominal GCR surface background is ~20-30 μSv/hr (MSL RAD baseline). On EVA, personal dosimeters track cumulative millisieverts. In the event of a Solar Particle Event (SPE) alert, immediately seek terrain shielding or subterranean lava tube/regolith shelter.
